AI Notes.value: DXR Zone was a 2-person London studio (Daniel Baragwanath and Rifke Sadleir), founded 2019, dissolved 20 May 2025. The studio is permanently closed; website domain (dxr.zone) expired and now redirects to a parked page. Client list was high-caliber: Google, Burberry, Nike, Selfridges, Dazed, Universal Music, Warp Records, Converse, The Face, Dropbox. Work spanned custom web builds, interactive/WebGL experiences, and art direction, primarily in fashion and music. Both founders were self-taught developers. After closure: Danny moved to VOID MAIN() (creative direction); Rifke Sadleir is freelancing and teaching at UAL CCI and Ravensbourne. Jonathan has a Day Rate (550) and Rating (4) on record, suggesting a prior relationship. Sources: itsnicethat.com, Companies House (dissolution), creativelivesinprogress.com, rifke.world, LinkedIn snippet.

Open Questions.value: 1. Capabilities: evidence shows web design and WebGL/interactive work alongside frontend dev -- add Web design + Creative technology?

Notes.value: Should we work with them? Yes. Are talented and seem organised, honest and cheerful. Set it up 2 years ago (you were overloading). They do all the design and development. Work mostly in fashion and music. Love-hate relationship with ecommerce. Microsite / visual interactive sites. If there is a necessity, they just learn the stack, depending on the timeframe. Stack: Kirby, Craft, Shopify, Snipcart; React.js, Vue.js (a little Next.js); Flask (Python, machine learning); Spark AR (filters). Started off as an elaborate meme then made filters. Availability: cooling down for February and March. Terms: 33% payment upfront, mid-point, and on completion; designs signed off before the build is completed. Studio day rate 500-600 GBP, project rate calculated from the studio rate. Depop: had a few chats, they provided a design, development on a staging site. Process: not set in stone; full transparency with the client, and if something unforeseen is on them they deal with it.
